context.passage:
To:
Isabel Koffler <ikoffler@allmail.com>
From:
Kerstin Eklund <kerstineklund@litowtreecare.com>
Date:
July 25
Subject:
RE: Tree job query
Attachment:
U Estimate
Dear Ms. Koffler,
Thank you for contacting Litow Tree Care about the work you need done. We would
gladly remove the 20-meter oak tree on your property and trim your hickory trees.
You also asked if we could cut a section from the oak tree so you can turn it into a dining
room table. We should be able to, but we need to see your tree first. As you noticed in the
reviews on our website, we have done that for several customers.
Unfortunately, we are already booked on the day you requested, Monday, July 30.
However, we can schedule your job for July 31 or August 1. If the attached estimate is
acceptable, please call me at 757-555-0111 to confirm your preferred date.
Sincerely,
Kerstin Eklund

choices: To thank Ms. Koffler for a referral
To ask Ms. Koffler to write a review
To confirm receipt of a revised estimate
To arrange a date for a job to start
items.question: What is one purpose of the e-mail?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：篇章中可定位到“However, we can schedule your job for July 31 or August 1.”。选择理由：该项复现或同义改写了定位信息，其他选项与原文细节不一致。正确答案：D（To arrange a date for a job to start）。
